test_title: PYST 32: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre of the table. A sits to the immediate right of F. D is sitting second to the right of A. C is fourth to the left of D. B is sitting between H and E. E is fourth to the right of G.

Who sits second to the left of A?
solution:
**Eight person: **A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H

1) A sits to the immediate right of F.

2) D is sitting second to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/343077e70fac8afaa9f4d654fafe798c294b66c7afd98eb8cba4b0d2a7931b49.png] 

3) C is fourth to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98c5d75bc6e087c4fc6f960a8368c408ca51c158e7cc08f08796727189c4317f.png] 

4) E is fourth to the right of G.

5) B is sitting between H and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ae8136ac7b015c9fd1f8499900db3bfcfe1e9cafa083721336a5f340c4f37bd.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **C is sits second to the left of A.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
